name: @thirdlight/protocol
description: Thirdlight M1 wire protocol (docs/contracts/sessions.md §3/§4/§5/§7/§11/§13; dependencies.md §3 surface row): HTTP payload types + strict parsers/validators, WS event types + strict validators/builders (the exhaustive §7 catalog), bridge message types + strict validators (the exhaustive §13.5 allowlist), and the ID syntax constants.
